# Catalog (generated, do not edit by hand)

Generated by `node scripts/catalog.js` from the engine. The AI must only use names from this file:
any other name is a validation error. Stage: 240 x 135 pixels. Run `node scripts/validate.js <file>`
to check a scenario.
